relationships.subject: TIMP-2
relationships.evidence_quote: each 1 ng/mL increase in plasma TIMP‐2 levels during the post‐acute phase was associated with 2.5‐fold higher odds of persistent arthralgia in the chronic phase

relationships.subject: MMP-2
relationships.evidence_quote: individuals who recovered within 90 days post symptom onset displayed significantly lower plasma MMP‐2 levels compared to both controls and individuals with persistent arthralgia

key_findings: Elevated post-acute plasma TIMP-2 independently predicted persistent arthralgia after chikungunya (OR 2.50), alongside skin rash and swollen joints.
No significant differences were found for MMP-1, MMP-3, MMP-9, MMP-14 or TIMP-1; lower MMP-2 marked recovery.
